title: Brawl Mod Manager Cloud Library
description: Mod source catalog for the separate Brawl Mod Manager Cloud Storage app. MEGA and Google Drive are user-selected file stores connected inside the app.

downloadBehavior.target: User-selected MEGA or Google Drive account
downloadBehavior.note: Intended workflow: locate the actual archive on the supplied source page, download it, extract and validate it, upload the extracted mod files to the user's selected MEGA or Google Drive account, then publish metadata for the Wii client. Not implemented yet; the Wii still requires a compatible network-loading bridge or temporary local cache.

excludedLocalInstallations.name: Smash REX
excludedLocalInstallations.reason: Already installed locally; do not duplicate in cloud catalog.

pending.name: Project Universe
pending.reason: Needs the original YouTube description/download link to identify the correct project.

cloudStorage.appRole: The Cloud Storage app manages discovery, link intake, download jobs, archive extraction, validation, organization, and Wii library access.
requirements: MEGA account integration using a supported secure authentication flow
Google OAuth client configuration and Google Drive API authorization when Google Drive is selected
secure server-side source downloader and archive processor
Wii-compatible network client and remote-loading bridge or temporary local cache
cloudStorage.security: Never collect provider passwords in the public app or commit OAuth client secrets, access tokens, or session credentials to the public repository.
cloudStorage.providerSelection: The user selects MEGA or Google Drive for each mod request.
